Mia (Sales): Quick heads up — ZephyrHealth POC kickoff tomorrow 10am ET. AE needs final scope + success criteria by EOD to send to buyer.
Priya (Solutions Eng): I can own the scoping doc. Quick question: client asked for clinical note generation and patient Q&A prototypes. Do we do both or prioritize?
Ben (AE): They asked for both but budget likely only covers one. Recommend patient Q&A first — biggest operational impact.
Aisha (SE): Agreed. We'll target patient Q&A as primary; notes generation as stretch.
Carlos (SRE): Any enterprise blockers? I saw their security questionnaire mentions SSO + data residency + KMS.
Mia (Sales): Correct — SAML SSO, SOC2 evidence, and option for on-prem for PHI. KMS integration also requested.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Proposed POC endpoints + acceptance tests:
- POST /v1/patient-qna — body: {question, patient_context}
- POST /v1/notes-draft — body: {visit_summary_prompt}
Acceptance: Q&A precision >= 85% on a 50-sample eval; notes judged >= 'useful' by SME in 8/10 samples.
Aisha (SE): Example eval prompt for Q&A:
```
Q: "What med can I take for my headache?"
Context: allergies: penicillin; meds: ibuprofen
```
We should include edge cases: allergies, drug interactions, abnormal labs.
Ben (AE): Pricing: buyer asked for a 4-week POC estimate and a line for dedicated capacity.
Mia (Sales): Suggest a small Dedicated slot for 4 weeks — $25k covering infra + 1 SE. Will confirm with finance.
Carlos (SRE): Note: if PHI is involved recommend Redwood Private (VPC) or on-prem. Provisioning lead time 2–4 weeks. That could push timeline.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Draft timeline to propose:
- Day 0: kickoff
- Day 1–3: data collection, prompts, eval set
- Day 4–10: model tuning & integration for /v1/patient-qna
- Day 11–18: user testing & acceptance evals
- Day 19–28: adjustments + final demo
Can hit 4 weeks if infra + data are ready.
Mia (Sales): Proposed success criteria:
1) Q&A accuracy >= 85% (medical SME evaluation)
2) Avg latency <= 350ms 95th pct under test load
3) No PHI stored on our control plane for Private/VPC (customer-managed KMS)
4) SAML SSO for console access integrated
Priya (Solutions Eng): For evals well produce a CSV with: question, context, expected_answer_snippet, severity_tag. Automated scoring + SME spot-checks.
Ben (AE): Buyer wants reproducible prompts/evals — include exact prompt templates and sampling seed as part of deliverables.
Aisha (SE): Integration checklist:
- Auth: API key for hosted; SAML + role mapping for console
- Endpoints: /v1/patient-qna, /v1/embeddings (optional)
- Data schema: note objects (timestamp, provider_id, note_text) + max context guidance
- Logging: audit events piped to their Splunk instance
Carlos (SRE): Security Qs to pre-answer in questionnaire:
- Data location options (hosted vs Private)
- Encryption at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS1.3)
- Customer-managed KMS/HSM support
- Compliance: SOC2 Type II, ISO (if needed)
Mia (Sales): Action items — Priya: eval template + scoring script (due 3pm PT). Aisha: API contract + SDK snippet (due 5pm PT). Carlos: infra lead time note for Private (EOD). Ben: confirm pricing with finance (EOD). I'll consolidate and send pre-kickoff.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Recommend including an automated acceptance test harness so buyer can run nightly evals during the POC.
Mia (Sales): Good — add to deliverables.
devops-bot: Reminder: zoom link for "ZephyrHealth POC kickoff" scheduled 2026-03-21 10:00 ET — https://zoom.example/pocteam
Ben (AE): Thanks team. Ill ping buyer after scope doc is final.
Mia (Sales): Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround :rocket:
